definitions: A slender threadlike object or fibre, especially one found in animal or plant structures.
A very fine thread or threadlike structure, such as the one in an electric light bulb that glows when heated.
The anther-bearing stalk of a stamen.
examples: The spider spun a delicate filament.
The light bulb's filament had broken.
Each stamen consists of a filament and an anther.
